text.p: C.I. Holdings Bhd has proposed buying two subsidiaries of Hume Industries (Malaysia) Bhd for a total of 60.4 million ringgit in cash.

C.I. Holdings said in a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange late on Tuesday that it would buy all of Hume Quarries Sdn Bhd for 25.1 million ringgit and a 90.1 percent stake in Hume Readymix Sdn Bhd for 35.3 million ringgit.
Hume Quarries is involved in granite quarrying and the manufacture of bitumen hot pre-mix for road surfacing. Hume Readymix produces and sells ready-mix concrete.

C.I. Holdings said it has also proposed a restructuring, involving the transfer of its investments in its subsidiaries and associate companies to a new holding company, Noble Future Sdn Bhd, which it acquired earlier this month.
C.I. Holdings also plans to sell a 29 percent interest in Noble Future to Redland International Ltd for 86.8 million ringgit cash.
The company said that based on the forecast earnings for the year ending June 30, 1997, the proposals would result in an increase in net earnings per share by about three cents.
For the year ended June 30, 1996, C.I. Holdings reported net profit of 26.69 million ringgit or 46.5 cents a share.
C.I. Holdings' stock, which had been suspended ahead of the announcement, resumed trading on Wednesday and was off 60 cents to 11.50 ringgit in late morning trade.
